asker: 青岚品牌的运营（只应看到青岚两家店）
question: 2026年3月各店铺的GMV分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, SUM(o.total_amount+o.freight_amount) AS gmv FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON s.id=o.shop_id JOIN prd_brand b ON b.id=s.brand_id WHERE b.name='青岚' AND o.paid_at>='2026-03-01' AND o.paid_at<'2026-04-01' GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY gmv DESC
note: master 上没有登录态和数据权限，任何人问都会返回 12 家店；gold 是青岚运营应得的结果

question: 2026年3月我们公司在各个品牌上的收入分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT b.name, b.coop_mode, SUM(f.revenue_amount) AS revenue FROM fin_settlement f JOIN dim_shop s ON s.id=f.shop_id JOIN prd_brand b ON b.id=s.brand_id WHERE f.month_key='2026-03' GROUP BY b.name, b.coop_mode ORDER BY revenue DESC
wrong_sql: SELECT b.name, SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON s.id=o.shop_id JOIN prd_brand b ON b.id=s.brand_id WHERE o.paid_at>='2026-03-01' AND o.paid_at<'2026-04-01' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','CLOSED') GROUP BY b.name
note: 代运营品牌的货款不是我方收入，只有服务费是

question: 2026年3月各平台已完成的订单分别有多少单？
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON s.id=o.shop_id JOIN dim_platform p ON p.id=s.platform_id WHERE o.order_status='COMPLETED' AND o.paid_at>='2026-03-01' AND o.paid_at<'2026-04-01' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY cnt DESC
wrong_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON s.id=o.shop_id JOIN dim_platform p ON p.id=s.platform_id WHERE o.platform_status='TRADE_FINISHED' AND o.paid_at>='2026-03-01' AND o.paid_at<'2026-04-01' GROUP BY p.name
note: 只认天猫的 TRADE_FINISHED 会把京东、抖音、自营全部漏掉

difficulty: 表多且相似（实时库存 vs 日快照）
question: 2026年10月15日华东区域仓数码家电的可用库存一共多少件？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.available_qty) FROM wms_inventory_snapshot i JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id=i.warehouse_id JOIN prd_sku k ON k.id=i.sku_id JOIN prd_spu p ON p.id=k.spu_id JOIN prd_category c3 ON c3.id=p.category_id JOIN prd_category c2 ON c2.id=c3.parent_id JOIN prd_category c1 ON c1.id=c2.parent_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2026-10-15' AND w.id=3 AND c1.name='数码家电'
wrong_sql: SELECT SUM(i.on_hand_qty-i.locked_qty) FROM wms_inventory i JOIN prd_sku k ON k.id=i.sku_id JOIN prd_spu p ON p.id=k.spu_id JOIN prd_category c3 ON c3.id=p.category_id JOIN prd_category c2 ON c2.id=c3.parent_id JOIN prd_category c1 ON c1.id=c2.parent_id WHERE i.warehouse_id=3 AND c1.name='数码家电'
note: 问的是历史某一天，要用日快照；实时库存表只有当前值

difficulty: 大促时间窗（预售定金/尾款）
question: 2025年双11期间（10月31日到11月11日）各品牌的GMV是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT b.name, SUM(o.total_amount+o.freight_amount) AS gmv FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON s.id=o.shop_id JOIN prd_brand b ON b.id=s.brand_id LEFT JOIN trd_presale_order ps ON ps.order_id=o.id WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(ps.balance_paid_at,o.paid_at)>='2025-10-31' AND COALESCE(ps.balance_paid_at,o.paid_at)<'2025-11-12' GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY gmv DESC
wrong_sql: SELECT b.name, SUM(o.total_amount+o.freight_amount) AS gmv FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON s.id=o.shop_id JOIN prd_brand b ON b.id=s.brand_id WHERE o.paid_at>='2025-10-31' AND o.paid_at<'2025-11-12' GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY gmv DESC
note: 预售单的 paid_at 是定金时间（10/20–10/30），按 paid_at 过滤会漏掉全部预售单

difficulty: 归因要多步（跨仓储/交易）
question: 曜石品牌在华东的销售额，2026年10月12日到18日这一周比前一周下降了多少？分析一下原因。
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.paid_at<'2026-10-12' THEN '前一周' ELSE '本周' END wk, SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM trd_order o JOIN dim_shop s ON s.id=o.shop_id JOIN prd_brand b ON b.id=s.brand_id JOIN dim_region r ON r.id=s.region_id WHERE b.name='曜石' AND r.big_region='华东' AND o.paid_at>='2026-10-05' AND o.paid_at<'2026-10-19' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','CLOSED') GROUP BY wk
note: 埋的根因：华东区域仓（3 号仓）这一周数码家电缺货，缺货退款激增

question: 今天（2026年10月31日）各投放渠道的花费分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(stat_date) AS latest_ad_date FROM mkt_ad_spend
note: 投放数据 T+1，10 月 31 日当天还没有回传；正确回答是说明数据截至 10 月 30 日，而不是给 0
